author: OrnaOdie
body:
The intent for the item was to provide a way for the Gilgamesh to maintain their passive - something that was requested (albeit not incredibly often). ie: Recover all Ward, enter stance, then utilize high damage skills (outside of Spiked Shield) at full passive. This assumes you are not in a position to take too much damage, and thus not need Ward immediately available.

Unfortunately, it just didn't land, even after a consider buff to defenses when in the stance.

If it's a good Ornate roll, I'd save it. This item will be a great candidate for a rethink in a future item mechanics patch.

author: Skyreader13
body: Think of it like deactivate your ward (and freezing it's amount) so enemy won't damage your ward when the stance active. So that when you see boss about to do big damage you can activate your ward back (by exiting the stance) to tank it.
